text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A perilous spring. Yet, even in the midst of it, Neo Universe and I refused to play it safe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daring to plunge headfirst into the asteroid belt—she seized glory.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe!!
Neo Universe achieves the Senior Spring Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the Tenno Sho (Spring), and the Takarazuka Kinen.
She has claimed victory in all three of these GⅠ races!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe and the others have mastered the "old route."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"This is what I wanted to do in the other universe..."
"I 'salvaged' a dream that ran aground..."
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was quite an adventure, though.
Yeah, it was an adventure, though

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Conquering the Spring Senior Triple Crown was a major goal for Neo Universe in another universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there is a reason why we ran in the
Takarazuka Kinen, even though we intentionally
left it off our target races this time.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Was what Neo Universe gained an "afterglow"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Things are different from that spring. More than anything, that was the confidence I wanted to give her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exit she's aiming for is right there.
Achieving this great feat will be
a huge driving force for Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—that night.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... do you know of it?
The "Summer Triangle".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Summer Triangle." I'm pretty sure I've heard of it.
Right...
choice_data_list: Was it the constellations in the summer night sky?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Formed by Alpha Cygni, Alpha Aquilae, and Alpha Lyrae...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Then what about the Autumn Triangle?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Autumn Triangle"... was something I'd never heard of.
As I tilted my head in confusion...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "Autumn Triangle" is—Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because in the past, I conquered all three. And to match Zenno Rob Roy in total mass...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe also had to become
part of the "Spring Triangle".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Now the two of us are—"SASA".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sense of rivalry toward Zenno Rob Roy,
who once conquered the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.
It seems Neo Universe possessed that as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Neo Universe asks.
Trainer... which one?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Memories of the... "Spring Triangle."
Which race was your absolute "favorite"?
choice_data_list: Hmm, which one could it be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every single one was a race dear to my heart.
As I pondered—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe is……"Tenno Sho (Spring)."
choice_data_list: Was that... because it was the "GATE"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Negative.
The reason is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because they "prayed for" me.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. The Neo Universe in another universe placed 3rd
in the Kikuka Sho...
Missing out on the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I finished 10th in the Tenno Sho (Spring) too...
I guess 'LODI' just wasn't my thing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And so, "you"
"prayed" to the "tail of the comet"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "What I couldn't do with 'myself'... I'll do with the one who inherits 'me'..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, Neo Universe...
really wanted to do it all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That is why I awakened the stars. And surpassed "LODI".
That race was――the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe used to be "LODI"...
In other words, long distance was not her forte.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A wish entrusted to their descendants. They must have wanted to see it through with their own two hands no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: When I missed the Classic Triple Crown... Neo Universe made "you" say "I'm sorry" so many times...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“The one who was 『disappointing』 was Neo Universe.
That's why—”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe――won't lose anymore.
I'll become a Neo Universe who won't lose even in "LODI"――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Right here... I'm right here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown that once slipped through my fingers.
That—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe crossed dimensions
and delivered it as a brand-new crown.
